## Report Security Issues
---

At WP Tailwatch, safeguarding our platform, our community, and the broader WordPress ecosystem is one of our highest priorities. We deeply appreciate, value, and welcome the efforts of independent security researchers and community members who help us maintain a secure environment for everyone.

If you have identified a potential security vulnerability, we invite and encourage you to report it to us responsibly. We are committed to collaborating with you openly, reviewing your findings promptly, and addressing validated issues swiftly.

---

## Please do not report security issues on GitHub

To ensure the safety of all users, we kindly ask that you **do not disclose security vulnerabilities publicly** on GitHub or other open platforms until we have had an opportunity to address them.

You can submit your findings confidentially through either of the following channels:
**Email:** Reach out directly to our security team at **security@wptailwatch.com**

## What to Include in Your Report
To help us evaluate and address your submission as efficiently as possible, please consider including:

* A clear description of the vulnerability and its potential security impact.
* Step-by-step instructions or a proof-of-concept (PoC) to help our team reproduce the behavior.
* Affected components or endpoints (e.g., specific PHP functions, REST API endpoints, or React UI interactions).
* Any suggested remediations or mitigations, if available.

---

## Our Commitment to You

When you report a security vulnerability to us in good faith, you can expect the following from our team:

* **Warm Acknowledgement:** We will review and confirm receipt of your report  **as soon as possible.**
* **Transparent Communication:** We will keep you updated throughout the investigation and remediation process.
* **Recognition & Attribution:** Once resolved, we will gladly offer a reward (if applicable) and credit your responsible disclosure in our release notes and hall of fame, unless you choose to remain anonymous.
